answer: The auditor assigns 1,000 unique reasoning tasks to each agent, functioning as a digital haven where every output receipt must be non-replayable. An honest agent spends 1,000 units of work, yet an attacker spawning 1,000 identities pays linearly more as no ember of logic can be reused. A verifier checks the raven-encoded audit log for errors; if a failure is found, the node is penalized. This assumes work is non-parallelizable.
